name: Mediterranean sea temperature (Copernicus)
summary: Daily gap-free satellite sea temperature maps of the Mediterranean (about 1 km), probably the best fit for Cyprus. Needs a free Copernicus Marine account, so it is not connected yet.

el.name: Θερμοκρασία θάλασσας Μεσογείου (Copernicus)
el.summary: Καθημερινοί δορυφορικοί χάρτες θερμοκρασίας θάλασσας της Μεσογείου χωρίς κενά (περίπου 1 km), μάλλον η καλύτερη επιλογή για την Κύπρο. Θέλει δωρεάν λογαριασμό Copernicus Marine, γι’ αυτό δεν έχει συνδεθεί ακόμη.

licence.attribution: Generated using E.U. Copernicus Marine Service Information; https://doi.org/10.48670/moi-00172

update.note: The product page lists daily updates at 12:00 and 15:00.

quality.uncertainty: Not read yet. The product page names the method (statistical interpolation of the best night-time satellite passes) but gives no error number.
known_issues: Night-time 'foundation' temperature at 00:00 UTC, free of daytime warming: it can read cooler than a beach on a sunny afternoon.
Gap-free: cloudy gaps are filled by statistical interpolation, so it is an estimate under cloud.

notes: Needs a free Copernicus Marine account (a Copernicus Data Space account also works). Not connected: the build sandbox could not test a login, and the data come as NetCDF/Zarr files, which this Node-only server cannot read yet. Product pages found: SST_MED_SST_L4_NRT_OBSERVATIONS_010_004 (this one, 1/100 and 1/16 degree), SST_MED_SST_L3S_NRT_OBSERVATIONS_010_012 (cloud gaps kept) and OCEANCOLOUR_MED_BGC_L3_NRT_009_141 (Mediterranean chlorophyll, not read).
